speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: There she is. I already ordered for you. Two of the green ones.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: You're the best person I know. How long's the line?

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: Ten minutes, the guy says, which means twenty. Want to walk the long way round the park?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Yes, please. I've been at my desk since eight.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: How's the big week going?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Honestly? Good. My first real customer call was this morning and it went really well. Anyway. Tell me something that isn't work.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: Okay. Big news. I made a bowl.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: A bowl! At the class?

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: At the class. It's a little lopsided. Okay, it's very lopsided. But it holds keys.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Is it for Dad? Because Mom just called. Sunday's at six thirty, and she says bring nothing.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: So I'm bringing the bowl.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: You're bringing the bowl.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: Uncle Marco's sixty. That's wild. What are you getting him?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: The old radio from the garage. If I can get it fixed by Sunday.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: The one he sings along to? Badly?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: That one. It hasn't worked since I was twelve.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: He's going to cry.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: He is absolutely going to cry.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: Oh, they called our number. Hey, Saturday morning, are we still running?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Seven, at the river path? Yes. Slowly.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: Slowly's the only speed I have. And are you going to Paris or not? Your mom texted me.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: She texted you?

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: She texts me about everything. Paris the city, right? Not the freight guy.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Paris the city. The trade show on the twenty-sixth. I'm booking it tonight.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: Book it now. I'll watch.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: After tacos.

speaker: Rosaline Capulet
text: After tacos. Deal.
